items.title: Where Natural Language Ends in Agents: Executable Skill Composition with MetaSkill
items.title_zh: 自然语言在智能体中的边界：用 MetaSkill 实现可执行技能组合
items.summary: MetaSkill is a hybrid representation that preserves complete Agent Skill packages and local instructions while making invocation dependencies and predecessor-text bindings executable through a directed-acyclic-graph runtime. Across 20 multi-skill artifact tasks and two LLMs, blinded artifact judgments favored it over natural-language procedures and prompt-visible graphs, audited GLM-5.2 traces satisfied every declared precedence constraint, and code is released.

items.title: Neuro-Inspired Inhibitory Message Passing for Accurate and Token-Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning
items.title_zh: 受神经科学启发的抑制性消息传递：更准确、更省 token 的多智能体推理
items.summary: The paper adapts cortical inhibition into inhibitory message passing, a training-free communication router that cancels redundant evidence separately for each sentence and receiver and forwards each restated evidence sentence at most once. Against standard message passing it raised peer-group accuracy by 39-77 percentage points and cut tokens per run by 10-46% across three benchmarks, seven open models and groups of up to 64 agents.

items.title: Arctic-SWE: Revisiting the Long Horizon Agent Training by Modeling-System Co-Design
items.title_zh: Arctic-SWE：以模型—系统协同设计重访长程智能体训练
items.summary: Arctic-SWE is a fully asynchronous reinforcement-learning framework that establishes a reproducible long-horizon agent baseline through model-system co-design. On raw R2E-Gym data it trains Qwen3.5-4B to 62.0% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified with about one-sixth as many rollouts as concurrent FrogNano, and curated data lifts the 4B model to 65.0%.

items.title: HybridResearcher: Bridging the Structured-Unstructured Boundary for Deep Research Agents
items.title_zh: HybridResearcher：打通结构化与非结构化边界的深度研究智能体
items.summary: HybridResearcher is a 4B agent built from synthesized cross-source trajectories and trained with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning to reason across structured and unstructured sources. On HybridDeepResearch it improves 30.0 points pass@8 over its Qwen3.5-4B base and surpasses the larger Qwen3.5-397B-A17B by 8.3 points.

items.title: CAT-RAG: Improving Secure Code Generation with Category-Aware Agentic Retrieval
items.title_zh: CAT-RAG：用类别感知的智能体检索改进安全代码生成
items.summary: CAT-RAG replaces CWE-level retrieval with compact, language-specific security categories chosen by an LLM categorizer agent, acting either as a standalone security layer or as a drop-in add-on to retrieval-augmented code generation. On CyberSecEval it nearly doubles the secure-code improvement over the prior state of the art, 23.57% versus 12.11%, while reducing token overhead by 41.71%.

items.title: A Cross-Domain Evaluation of Prompting Techniques for Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 大语言模型提示技术的跨领域评估
items.summary: One LLM is compared across zero-shot prompting, few-shot prompting, RAG and a PE2-inspired automatic prompt-optimization pipeline on six benchmarks covering arithmetic, logical and commonsense reasoning plus factual verification. No strategy consistently won, pairwise differences among the best configurations were not significant, and RAG had the highest average accuracy at 78.33% with 300 retrieval examples.

items.title: Measuring Data Diversity with Embeddings: A Taxonomy and Benchmark for Diversity Measures
items.title_zh: 用嵌入衡量数据多样性：多样性度量的分类与基准
items.summary: The authors present a taxonomy of 21 embedding-based diversity measures grouped into four families and introduce EmbDivBench, which evaluates them on variety, balance and disparity using simulated and natural text. Mean Pairwise Distance, the most commonly used measure, was outperformed on those components, with Graph Entropy the best overall choice.

items.title: An Impossibility Result for ETF Target Geometry, and an Equinorm Remedy for Imbalanced Analytic Continual Learning
items.title_zh: ETF 目标几何的不可能性结果，以及面向不平衡解析持续学习的等范数补救
items.summary: The paper shows that fusing analytic continual learning with progressively expanded Simplex ETF targets is identical to plain one-hot ACIL, and that the literal expansion introduces about four times the catastrophic forgetting of a classic ACIL head. Applying equinorm post-processing to the fitted classifier weights instead recovers tail and overall accuracy under long-tailed imbalance, including +32.0 tail and +16.0 average points at 100:1 on CIFAR-100/ViT.

items.title: A Symmetry-Matching Approach to Blind-Spot Reduction in Sparse Autoencoders
items.title_zh: 用对称匹配方法减少稀疏自编码器的盲点
items.summary: The paper frames representation blind spots as a feature-basis orientation problem and adds a differentiable V_Gini regularisation term to sparse-autoencoder training that penalises uneven perturbation response within a specified family. Across GPT-2, Gemma 2 and Qwen 2.5, it raises relative and absolute lower-tail responses and reduces response-profile imbalance without material general-text reconstruction degradation, with a zero-shot clinical radiology minimal-pair audit finding weak-tail lift.

items.title: LLM-Based Evaluation Planning for Heterogeneous Optimization
items.title_zh: 面向异构优化的基于 LLM 的评估规划
items.summary: REP-HO replaces the rule-based mixed-fidelity selection step in heterogeneous optimization with an LLM planner that receives surrogate predictions, uncertainties, evaluation costs and budget status. Across five regimes one of its variants achieved the best mean ranking score in every regime, REP-HO(DeepSeek) placed first or second throughout, and the planner adapted allocation such as prioritizing constraint evaluations under tighter budgets.
